# Coverage matrix

Generated by `scripts/gen_coverage.py`. Do not edit by hand.

**garminconnect 0.3.20: 348 methods | garmin_mcp covers 109 | garmin-everything-mcp adds 178 (extras) / 265 (all) / 338 (full) auto-generated tools + 8 hand-written**

- Library: `garminconnect==0.3.20`, 348 public methods (274 read, 74 write).
- `garmin_mcp` wraps 105 client calls, 99 of which are `Garmin` methods in this version; together with tool names that shadow library methods it covers 109 of 348.
- Profile `extras` (default): 178 read tools that garmin_mcp does not provide.
- Profile `all`: 265 read tools (every read method, duplicates garmin_mcp names).
- Profile `full`: 338 tools including 73 write methods (needs `GARMIN_EVERYTHING_WRITES=1`).
- Skipped on purpose: 10 (session/raw/clock helpers; bytes methods are wrapped by overrides).
